name: Knee Arthrofibrosis
definition: Excessive scar formation causing clinically important loss of knee flexion and/or extension after surgery or trauma.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and MRI are used selectively to identify mechanical blocks or associated pathology.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, postoperative, infection, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Selected cases may require manipulation or lysis of adhesions.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Sandhi stambha phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Excessive scar formation causing clinically important loss of knee flexion and/or extension after surgery or trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, major trauma, unstable fracture/dislocation, sepsis/infection or other listed red flags.
